assessments.observation: Pixels show stable START, STOP, RESET and AUTO ON/OFF labels. Start frame shows AUTO and 'Applied by PLC'; Stop frame shows STOPPING and 'Applied by PLC'; Reset frame shows STOPPED with Reset 'Applied by PLC' and ResetAck 1 in control header; Auto frames show distinct ON/OFF selected states and 'Readback confirmed'. Independent PLC outputs show StartAck/StopAck then ResetAck=1.
assessments.uncertainty: Auto has readback only, no PLC Auto acknowledgement field as stated on HMI; that limitation was visible and not treated as a mode acknowledgement.

assessments.observation: Operation view has separate COMMAND and FEEDBACK (OBSERVED) columns. Start-result pixels show M1 RUN commanded while feedback is STOPPED with text 'Commanded; no running feedback yet'. Stop-result pixels show M1 OFF while feedback is RUNNING with text 'Not commanded; feedback still running (coast/stop)'. Diverts show RETRACT command separately from HOME/EXTENDED feedback. This distinguishes command from feedback rather than painting running solely from command.
assessments.uncertainty: Assessment is for the displayed command-versus-feedback distinction in the captured Start/Stop transitions; no carton/divert motion sequence was in scope.

assessments.observation: On the main Operation view without navigation, pixels show top banner 'PLC MODE Faulted', 'ALARMS 1 active - F10 Drive overload', red banner 'FAULT 10 Drive overload - Drive overload input is on. Faulted, motor off', Alarms tab badge 1, and CONTROLS heading FAULTED. Independent PLC output at 2745 is ModeText Faulted, FaultCode 10, FaultText Drive overload.
assessments.uncertainty: Only the injected drive-overload fault text was tested; other fault texts were not exercised.

assessments.observation: Healthy/fault frames show 'PLC DATA Fresh' with an age and a RELEASE-WCS panel, but no stale-data condition, unknown-quality condition, or WCS disconnect was induced or observed. Therefore stale/unknown and WCS-disconnect display behavior was not tested.
assessments.uncertainty: No stale/disconnect stimulus was performed in this UI checkpoint; a healthy Fresh indication cannot prove stale or disconnect handling.

claimBoundary: Exact frames were sent to Muse; trusted browser inputs, rendered outcomes and PLC acknowledgements are preserved. Pixel interpretations require separate review; inconclusive UI coverage remains inconclusive.
